items.title: IATA Cargo Experts Conference: Turning Expertise into Improved Air Cargo Operations
items.summary: IATA announced that the 2026 IATA Cargo Experts Conference (CEC) will focus on practical ways to improve day-to-day air cargo operations through global standards, technology, and data.

items.title: Aviation Industry Urges African Governments to Align API and PNR Programs with Global Standards
items.summary: The African Airlines Association (AFRAA), the Airlines Association of Southern Africa (AASA), and IATA urged African States to implement Advance Passenger Information (API) and Passenger Name Record (PNR) systems in accordance with ICAO standards and global best practices.

items.title: Air Passenger Demand Falls 1.7% in June
items.summary: IATA released data for June 2026 global passenger demand, showing overall contraction due to domestic market declines in China, the US, and Japan, and weak but improving international demand for Middle East carriers.

items.title: Air Cargo Demand Strengthens in June, Up 8.5%
items.summary: IATA released data for June 2026 global air cargo markets showing growth in demand in all regions, including the Middle East.

items.title: IATA, CANSO, and ACI Launch Joint Runway Safety Initiative
items.summary: IATA, the Civil Air Navigation Services Organisation (CANSO), and Airports Council International (ACI) have launched a joint initiative to reduce the risk of runway incursions.

items.title: IATA Board Appoints Saadia Zahidi as Director General
items.summary: IATA announced that Saadia Zahidi has been appointed by IATA’s Board of Directors to the position of Director General from 1 November 2026.

items.title: Statement on EU Commission Revision of the EU Emissions Trading System
items.summary: IATA is deeply frustrated at the proposed extension of the European Emissions Trading System beyond Europe’s borders, an approach that was discredited over a decade ago.

items.title: IATA Releases 2025 World Air Transport Statistics
items.summary: IATA has released the latest edition of the World Air Transport Statistics (WATS), providing comprehensive statistical data through to 2025.

items.title: IATA Guidance Supports Clearer and More Consistent In-Cabin Pet Travel
items.summary: IATA has released new operational guidance to support airlines in managing in-cabin pet travel at every stage of the journey from booking to check-in, boarding, the on-board experience, and arrival.

items.title: Air Passenger Demand Falls 2.2% in May
items.summary: IATA released data for May 2026 global passenger demand, showing overall contraction as an impact of war in the Middle East.

items.title: Air Cargo Demand Up 6.0% in May
items.summary: IATA released data for May 2026 global air cargo markets showing growth in demand in all regions except for the Middle East.

items.title: IATA and IATP Collaborate to Support Airline Supply Chain Resilience
items.summary: IATA and the International Airlines Technical Pool (IATP) have agreed to cooperate in helping airlines to improve their visibility of, and access to, aircraft parts.

items.title: Urgent Action Needed to Ease Engine MRO Bottlenecks
items.summary: IATA, in collaboration with Emerton, today released a new study examining bottlenecks in the maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO) of latest-generation single-aisle aircraft engines.

items.title: IATA Outlines Four Priorities to Strengthen the Aviation Supply Chain
items.summary: IATA identified four priorities to address persistent failures in the aerospace supply chain at the inaugural IATA World Maintenance and Engineering Symposium in Madrid.

items.title: States and Supporting Partners Join IATA’s Alliance to Expand CORSIA Carbon Credit Supply
items.summary: IATA announced that the number of entities participating in the Supporting Alliance for CORSIA Eligible Emissions Unit (EEU) Supply has reached 50.

items.title: EU261 Reform Misses the Mark on Delays and Competitiveness
items.summary: IATA expressed frustration that revisions to EU261 stopped short of the meaningful reform needed to address the regulation’s deep flaws

items.title: IATA Turbulence Aware Coverage of Latin America Boosted
items.summary: IATA’s Turbulence Aware coverage of Latin America has been significantly boosted as Aeromexico becomes the latest airline to join the program.

items.title: IATA Launches “Save a Life, Not a Bag” Passenger Safety Campaign
items.summary: IATA today announced the launch of “Save a Life, Not a Bag”, a passenger safety campaign urging travelers not to take cabin baggage during an aircraft evacuation.

items.title: Brazil’s Opportunity to Be a SAF Powerhouse
items.summary: IATA highlighted Brazil’s opportunity to become a SAF powerhouse as its 82nd Annual General Meeting gathered in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

items.title: IATA PaxInsight Survey Offering Strengthens in Trans-Atlantic Market with Inclusion of Virgin Atlantic
items.summary: IATA has announced a strengthening of its IATA PaxInsight passenger satisfaction benchmarking program with the addition of Virgin Atlantic’s trans-Atlantic routes to the survey.

items.title: Winners of the 8th Edition of IATA Diversity & Inclusion Awards Announced
items.summary: IATA announced the winners of the IATA Diversity & Inclusion Awards 2026.

items.title: Roberto Alvo Chairs the IATA Board of Directors
items.summary: IATA announced that Roberto Alvo, CEO of LATAM Airlines Group, has taken up duties as Chair of the IATA Board of Directors.

items.title: Xiamen Airlines to Host 83rd IATA AGM
items.summary: IATA announced that Xiamen Airlines will host the 83rd IATA Annual General Meeting (AGM) and World Air Transport Summit (WATS) in Xiamen, China, from 30 May to 1 June 2027.

items.title: Middle East Disruptions and High Fuel Prices Halve Airline Industry Profitability
items.summary: IATA released its latest financial outlook for the global airline industry showing a halving of profitability as a result of war-related Middle East disruptions and high fuel prices.

items.title: IATA Launches Supporting Alliance for CORSIA EEU Supply
items.summary: IATA launched the Supporting Alliance for CORSIA EEU Supply, regrouping stakeholders across the CORSIA ecosystem in efforts to boost the availability of 225-250 million CORSIA Eligible Emission Units (EEUs) by spring 2027.
